classification: source-confirmed conditional diagnostic classification disagreement; no seed occurrence or run claimed
title: Shield contacts are counted as weapon contacts in per-combatant autoresolve summaries
earliest_failed_contract: The global and per-defender report classify the same blocked contact independently. Global identity-based implement classification distinguishes a shield; the per-defender predicate treats any successful Block/Parry as a weapon contact.
counterexample: A coherent BattleLogEntry with defender_response Block, outcome Blocked, and defender_contact_item_id equal to the buckler id rather than the equipped arming-sword id increments shield_contacts globally but effective_weapon_contacts for that defender. Actual normal roster includes Shield Militiaman with arming sword and Some(buckler). No seed was run and no claim that any particular run produced this event.
actual_recipient: 2014 record_autoresolve_combatant_causal writes per-defender effective_weapon_contacts;2017 record_autoresolve_implement writes global weapon_defense_contacts or shield_contacts for the same log entries, both retained in iteration report.
qualification: The source predicates prove conditional misattribution, and normal roster admits shield use. Exact Core blocked-shield event producer/occurrence remains a dependency before asserting normal-run occurrence. Physical combat resolution is not implicated by a report-classification error.
connected_repair: Classify defensive contact once using actual defender implement identity and share that classification between total and per-combatant summaries; keep shield and weapon contacts distinct.
acceptance: A blocked buckler contact increments shield-specific totals and never effective weapon contacts; a weapon block increments corresponding weapon counters consistently. No execution or new tests in this audit.
